Data Streaming Architecture Processes First-Party Data in Real Time
Rapid Time to Value Across the Organization
Seamless, Real-Time Interoperability across the Customer Engagement Technology Stack
Customer Engagement Expertise and Highly Engaged Community
Privacy, Data Security and Data Protection
paragraphs: To forge vibrant connections between people and the brands they love, fueled by a community that inspires and technology that lights the way.

Braze is a leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging. Customer Engagement is an emerging category of business activity and software which we define as the full set of activities that companies use to build and maintain direct, meaningful relationships with their customers. Our platform brings together rich, first-party context, transforms that context with composable intelligence (models, agents, and operators), and delivers continuous, and personally relevant interactions across channels. As of January 2026, 2,609 customers around the world trusted Braze to power their cross-channel customer engagement strategies. In January 2026, our platform enabled interactions with 8.0 billion monthly active users via our customers' apps, websites, and other digital interfaces, up from 7.2 billion in January 2025.

Our bond with technology has strengthened immensely over the past decade as we welcomed connected devices, digital services, and, most recently, artificial intelligence, or AI, into nearly every part of our lives. Braze was founded in 2011 in response to the step change in human history ushered in by the smartphone, when we became significantly more connected to each other and to the products and services that brands compete to sell to us. Today, we interact with many brands across a myriad of digital and physical touchpoints. The first-party data generated from the increase in digital touchpoints in particular has provided brands with new opportunities to reach customers with the right message at the right time, but it has also increased consumer expectations for brands to understand and anticipate their needs regardless of where they interact. The ongoing platform shift to AI has further elevated expectations for a personalized experience and creates new opportunities for brands to connect with their customers. These trends have put competitive pressure on brands to increase their focus and investment on customer experience. Successful brands now use customer engagement software that leverages first-party data to make customer relationships actionable while differentiating them from their competition and ultimately transforming their businesses. The end results are more lasting customer relationships that increase brand loyalty and customer value over time. We view our own role as steward of a brand's first party relationships, achieved through the sophisticated management of their first-party data, as well as the orchestration and delivery of critical components of their marketing and product experience across an increasingly non-linear and digital customer journey.

Most cross-channel marketing automation platforms available today approach customer engagement on a channel-by-channel or campaign-by-campaign basis, which creates data and engagement silos that result in disjointed customer experiences and diminishes customer loyalty. We built Braze to facilitate the craft of customer engagement—a pursuit that is distinct from merely the activity of sending marketing messages. The craft of customer engagement brings together diverse skillsets, bold creativity, the sophisticated use of AI, data, and an agile, experimental approach to the strategy that unlocks value in more of
the moments that matter for customers as they move through their journey with a brand.

In addition to avoiding siloed channels and data, our platform empowers real-time engagement between brands and their customers. The real-time nature of the interactions we enable is crucial, and is made possible by our proprietary, enterprise-grade stream processing architecture. This architecture underpins the Braze Data Platform which receives, contextualizes, and responds to first-party customer data in the moment. We have designed it to listen like a human would, process new information in context, and react instantaneously, enabling marketers to run engagement campaigns and messaging that feel relevant, personal, and human.

Braze also unleashes the power of interdisciplinary teams by serving numerous stakeholders beyond traditional marketers and creative teams, including product and engineering teams, business intelligence, data science, and data engineering teams. Our platform produces valuable data that informs decisions and actions across customer engagement strategies. Our engagement capabilities transcend marketing use cases, often being used for product or transactional use cases that facilitate or enhance the consumer's experience with the brand or product. As a result, Braze is often a critical part of our customers' communications infrastructure.

Our platform is also designed to serve the needs of customers across sizes, stages of growth, industries, and geographies. Our customers include many established global enterprises and leading technology innovators. We employ a land-and-expand business model centered around offering products that are easy to adopt and have a rapid time to value. We expand our reach within existing customers when our customers add new channels, purchase additional subscription products, implement new engagement strategies, or onboard new business units and geographies. We also grow as our customers grow because our pricing is based in large part on the number of consumers that our customers reach and the volume of messages our customers send.

A key aspect of Braze's differentiation is that we offer a platform, not a point solution, that gives brands an end-to-end solution for achieving their customer engagement goals, not just a tool to send messages. We vertically integrate our data activation, insights and segmentation, orchestration, personalization and relevance capabilities and also leverage AI investments across each layer of the stack, so coordinating between them is simple and fast. Meanwhile, we abstract away the particulars of disparate data sources through our Braze Data Platform and the vagaries of the many messaging channels we support, so that when marketers implement their customer engagement strategies in Braze, they can maintain a customer-centric mindset – focused on the intersection of the goals of their brand with the needs of the consumer, not the complexity of data integrations or siloed message channels. This also provides consistency across Braze's insights and segmentation, orchestration, and relevance feature set, making it easier for our customers to expand across channels, and allowing our research and development investments into areas like BrazeAI Decisioning Studio and BrazeAI Agent Console or Braze's Canvas visual development environment to deliver broad impact quickly and efficiently.

This product architecture supports differentiated use of AI and machine learning through its comprehensive access to first party-data, and an ability to directly take action to guide the customer journey. When deployed by our customers, our platform is typically leveraged across consumer touchpoints and sources of first-party data, including integration of the Braze software development kits, or SDKs, into end-user applications, ChatGPT applications, foundational LLM models through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), websites, and the configuration of automated connections into customer data warehouses or data platforms via the Braze Data Platform. This enables more advanced experimentation and automated decision making and also creates the opportunity to personalize and optimize customer journeys at scale. With BrazeAI, marketers can improve outcomes for both consumers and brands by creating experiences with relevant content, journeys, and offers tailored to each individual. Our platform also has the promise to improve operational efficiency for the teams that use Braze – as we continue to expand our product surface area and enhance its capabilities by infusing AI, we can help brands create personalized, cross-channel solutions faster with BrazeAI Operator, and compound their learnings through automated experimentation and data analysis, ultimately increasing their return on investment over time.

Within the orchestration layer, we enable marketers to easily design, visualize, and launch customer journeys utilizing Canvas, our proprietary, no-code journey orchestration tool. With Canvas's comprehensive journey testing, marketers can also test, implement, and optimize the most effective channels, cadence, messaging, or creative elements from a single tool. As the usability of Canvas has improved over time, more customer communication and engagement workloads have adopted it, which we believe cements Braze in our customers' technology ecosystems. We have also developed, and continue to refine, an AI recommendation engine that utilizes a custom-trained transformer model to match items for Braze Catalogs with customers more likely to buy them, providing content personalization that can outperform competing techniques.

We support interactions across both in-product and out-of-product messaging channels. Today, our messaging channels consist of widely used digital channels such as email; mobile messaging such as SMS, MMS, and RCS messages, WhatsApp and LINE messaging, and webhooks; as well as in-product and web experiences such as in-app messages (including in-product messaging to apps on connected TV and gaming platforms), in-browser messages, surveys, mobile and web push notifications, Braze Content Cards and Banners– which are flexible, content-rich messages embedded in a mobile app or web browsers,

Landing Pages– which are standalone web pages with a single call-to-action often used for audience acquisition and conversion, and Feature Flags– which allow our customers to remotely enable or disable mobile or web experiences for different audiences. Finally, Braze Audience Sync also unifies owned and paid channel strategies across platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, LinkedIn, The Trade Desk, and Criteo. The flexibility of our platform also allows us to add new channels quickly and efficiently as they become relevant to our customers.

We enable brands to easily integrate our platform with both in-house technical infrastructure and our expanding partner ecosystem of best-in-class technologies. For instance, capabilities within the Braze Data Platform allow our customers to set up a direct connection between their data warehouses or platforms and Braze to automatically sync relevant user attributes, events, and purchases. Once synced to Braze, this data can be imported into any layer of our platform and can be leveraged for use cases such as personalization or segmentation. Customers can also use the Braze Data Platform to stream data in real time to those systems, which increases the return on our customers' other technology investments. We support direct integrations with a range of providers, including cloud data service and warehouses, customer data platforms, analytics and reporting solutions, as well as other components of the modern marketing technology ecosystem such as eCommerce and Software-as-a-Service, or SaaS, applications.

headings: Risks Related to Our Growth and Capital Requirements
Unstable market and economic conditions may have serious adverse consequences on our business, financial condition and share price.

Our rapid revenue growth may not be indicative of our future revenue growth. Our rapid revenue growth also makes it difficult to evaluate our future prospects and may increase the risk that we will not be successful.
We may require additional capital to support business growth, and this capital might not be available on acceptable terms, if at all.
We have a history of operating losses and may not achieve or sustain profitability in the future.
Risks Related to Our Business and Our Brand
If we are unable to attract new customers and renew existing customers, our business, financial condition and results of operations will be adversely affected.
Failure to effectively develop our sales and marketing capabilities could harm our ability to expand our customer base and achieve broader market adoption of our platform and products.
We are dependent on a single platform, and the failure to achieve continued market acceptance of our platform could cause our results of operations to suffer.
We may need to reduce prices or change our pricing model to remain competitive.
Our sales cycle with large enterprise customers can be long and unpredictable, and our sales efforts require considerable time and expense.
Our business and reputation could be adversely affected if our customers are not satisfied with the integration, implementation, or services provided by us or our partners.

Because we generally recognize revenue ratably over the term of each subscription agreement, downturns or upturns in our sales may not be immediately reflected in our financial condition and results of operations.
If we fail to maintain and enhance our brand, our ability to expand our customer base may be impaired and our business, financial condition and results of operations may suffer.
If we fail to manage our growth effectively, we may be unable to execute our business plan, maintain high levels of service and customer satisfaction or adequately address competitive challenges.
paragraphs: Our operations and financial results are subject to various risks and uncertainties, including those described below. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and our consolidated financial statements and related notes. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. Additional risk and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we presently deem less significant may also impair our business operations. If any of the events or circumstances described in the following risk factors is realized, our business, operating results, financial condition, cash flows, and prospects could be materially and adversely affected. In that event, the market price of our Class A common stock could decline, and you could lose part or all of your investment.

Our business operations are subject to numerous risks, factors and uncertainties, including those outside of our control, that could cause our actual results to be harmed, including risks regarding the following:
•Unstable market and economic conditions may have serious adverse consequences on our business, financial condition, and share price.

•Our rapid revenue growth may not be indicative of our future revenue growth. Our rapid revenue growth also makes it difficult to evaluate our future prospects and may increase the risk that we will not be successful.
•We may require additional capital to support business growth, and this capital might not be available on acceptable terms, if at all.

•We have a limited history operating at our current scale, and our future results of operations may fluctuate significantly due to a wide range of factors, which make it difficult to forecast our future results of operations.

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and related notes that are included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. In addition to historical financial information, the following discussion contains forward-looking statements that are based upon current plans, expectations and beliefs that involve risks and uncertainties. Our actual results may differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of various factors, including, but not limited to, those set forth under the section entitled "Risk Factors" in Item 1A of Part I of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. See "Special Note Regarding Forward Looking Statements" in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

For a discussion regarding our financial condition and results of operations for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2025 compared to the fiscal year ended January 31, 2024, refer to "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition
and Results of Operations" in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for our fiscal year ended January 31, 2025, filed with the SEC on April 1, 2025.

Braze is a leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging. Our platform brings together rich, first-party context, transforms that context with composable intelligence (models, agents, and operators), and delivers continuous, and personally relevant interactions across channels. Using our platform, brands ingest and process customer data in real time, orchestrate and optimize contextually relevant marketing campaigns across multiple channels. Our platform is designed so that interactions between brands and consumers have the same relevance and cross-channel continuity as human interactions.

Our customers include many established global enterprises and leading technology innovators, and span a wide variety of sizes and industries, including retail and consumer goods, media and entertainment, gaming, sports, restaurants and on-demand services, healthcare and life sciences, technology, and financial services.

We primarily generate revenue from the sale of subscriptions to customers for the use of our platform. Our subscription fees are principally based on an upfront commitment by our customers for messaging volumes, a specific number of monthly active users, platform access and/or support and certain add-on products. Additionally, we provide professional services, which better enable customers to successfully onboard and use our platform, including certain premium professional services such as email deliverability support and dedicated technical support staff.

We employ a land-and-expand business model centered around offering products that are easy to adopt and have a rapid time to value. We expand our reach within existing customers when our customers add new channels, purchase additional subscription products, implement new engagement strategies, or onboard new business units and geographies. We also grow as our customers grow because our pricing is based in large part on the number of consumers that our customers reach and the volume of messages our customers send. Accordingly, as our customers increase the use of our platform and increase the number of end users reached via our platform, the value of our contracts with such customers also increases.

We have grown significantly in recent periods. We generated revenue of $738.2 million, $593.4 million, and $471.8 million in the fiscal years ended January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, respectively, representing year-over-year growth of 24.4% from the fiscal years ended January 31, 2025 to January 31, 2026 and 25.8% from the fiscal year ended January 31, 2024 to January 31, 2025. We had net losses of $130.8 million, $104.0 million and $130.4 million, in the fiscal years ended January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, respectively. We had net cash provided by operating activities of $71.4 million, $36.7 million, and $6.9 million in the fiscal years ended January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, respectively. Our non-GAAP free cash flow was $58.1 million, $19.6 million and $(6.5) million in the fiscal years ended January 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, respectively. See the section titled "— Non-GAAP Free Cash Flow" for additional information about how we calculate free cash flow, a non-GAAP financial metric, and a reconciliation to net cash provided by operating activities, the most directly comparable measure calculated in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States, or U.S. GAAP.

We believe there is substantial opportunity to continue to grow our customer base. We intend to continue to expand our customer base in verticals where we already have a strong presence, such as retail and consumer goods, media and entertainment, telecommunications, restaurants and on-demand services, healthcare and life sciences, technology, manufacturing, education, government and public services, and financial services — and to increase our presence in verticals where we are not yet strongly represented. Through our sales and marketing efforts, we also plan to capitalize on industries subject to ongoing digital transformation and where direct-to-consumer relationships are accelerating, to further propel adoption of our technology. As of January 31, 2026, we had 2,609 customers across a broad range of sizes and industries. Our ability to attract new customers will depend on a number of factors, including the quality and pricing of our products, offerings of our competitors and the effectiveness of our marketing efforts.

We define a customer as the separate and distinct, ultimate parent-level entity that has an active subscription with us to use our products. A single organization could have multiple distinct contracting divisions or subsidiaries, all of which together would be considered a single customer.

We believe we can achieve significant growth by expanding sales within our existing customer base. We expand the use of our platform by existing customers by, among others, adding new channels and increasing the messaging volume we sell to

our customers as their businesses and needs continue to grow and as they connect directly with additional consumers, which in turn leads to a need for greater messaging capacity. We intend to continue to invest in developing and enhancing our products and functionality. Our ability to increase sales to existing customers will depend on a number of factors, including our customers' satisfaction with our solutions, the ability of our customers to attract new end users, competition, pricing and overall changes in our customers' spending levels.

Historically, we have experienced significant expansion within a customer's business once our platform is deployed, with customers typically increasing the number of monthly active users, channels and use cases, as well as purchasing additional products. A monthly active user is an end user of a customer who has engaged with the customer's applications and websites in the previous thirty-day period. We include each distinguishable end user in our calculation of monthly active users, even though some users may access our customers' applications and websites using more than one device, and multiple users may gain access using the same device. As of January 31, 2026, we had approximately 8.0 billion monthly active users, up from approximately 7.2 billion monthly active users as of January 31, 2025.

Braze supports interactions across a broad range of both in-product and out-of-product messaging channels. The flexibility of our platform also allows us to add new channels quickly and efficiently as they become relevant to our customers. The breadth of channels we offer, and our ability to efficiently expand our offering of channels, allows us to expand our reach within existing customers as they purchase additional channels from us.

paragraphs: 為建立人們與他們喜愛的品牌之間活絡的連結，並以一個能激勵人心的社羣與能引導前進的科技為動力。

Braze 是一個領先的客戶互動平台，協助品牌實現絕對的互動。客戶互動是商業活動與軟體的一個新興類別，我們定義為企業用以建立與維持與客戶之間直接且有意義關係的全部活動。我們的平台結合豐富的第一方情境資料，透過可組合的智慧（模型、代理與運算器）轉化這些情境資料，並透過各個通路提供持續且個人化的互動。截至 2026 年 1 月，全球有 2,609 家客戶信任 Braze 來驅動他們的跨通路客戶互動策略。在 2026 年 1 月，我們的平台透過客戶的應用程式、網站及其他數位介面，使每月活躍使用者達到 8.0 十億，較 2025 年 1 月的 7.2 十億有所成長。

我們與科技的連結在過去十年中大幅強化，我們迎來了連接裝置、數位服務，以及最近的人工智慧（AI）進入我們生活的幾乎每個部分。Braze 於 2011 年成立，當時智慧型手機的出現改變了人類歷史，我們變得與彼此以及品牌競爭銷售給我們的產品與服務更加連接。今天，我們透過許多數位與實體接觸點與品牌互動。特別是數位接觸點的增加，產生的第一方資料為品牌提供了新的機會，能在正確的時間以正確的訊息觸及客戶，但也提高了消費者對品牌理解與預測其需求的期待，不管他們在哪個接觸點互動。持續的平台轉型至 AI 更進一步提高了對個人化體驗的期待，並為品牌與客戶建立連結創造了新的機會。這些趨勢已使品牌面臨增加對客戶體驗的關注與投資的競爭壓力。成功的品牌現在使用能運用第一方資料使客戶關係可操作的客戶互動軟體，同時與競爭對手區隔，並最終轉型他們的業務。最終結果是更持久的客戶關係，並隨著時間增加品牌忠誠度與客戶價值。我們視自己的角色為品牌第一方關係的管理者，透過對其第一方資料的精緻管理，以及在日益非線性與數位的客戶旅程中協調與交付其行銷與產品體驗的關鍵零組件。
目前大多數跨通路的行銷自動化平台都以通路為單位或以行銷活動為單位來處理客戶互動，這會造成資料與互動的孤島，導致客戶體驗不連貫，並降低客戶忠誠度。我們建立 Braze 是為了促進客戶互動的藝術——這是一種追求，與單純發送行銷訊息的活動有所不同。客戶互動的藝術結合了多樣化的專業技能、大膽的創意、對 AI、資料的精緻運用，以及對策略的靈活與實驗性方法，以解鎖更多價值。
客戶在與品牌互動的旅程中，那些對他們而言至關重要的時刻。
除了避免渠道與數據的孤島現象，我們的平台賦予品牌與客戶之間即時互動的能力。我們所啟動的互動即時性至關重要，這是由我們專屬的企業級流處理架構所實現。此架構支撐 Braze Data Platform，該平台能即時接收、理解並回應第一方客戶數據。我們設計此架構使其能像人類一樣聆聽，並在情境中處理新資訊，並立即做出反應，使行銷人員能夠執行感覺相關、個人化且具人性化互動的行銷活動。
Braze 還透過跨領域團隊的協作，發揮其潛力，服務的對象不僅限於傳統的行銷與創意團隊，還包括產品與工程團隊、商業智慧、數據科學與數據工程團隊。我們的平台產生的數據對客戶互動策略的決策與行動具有重要價值。我們的互動能力超越行銷應用場景，常被用於產品或交易性場景，以促進或提升消費者與品牌或產品的體驗。因此，Braze 通常是我們客戶溝通基礎設施中的關鍵組成部分。

我們的平台也設計用以服務不同規模、成長階段、產業與地理區域的客戶。我們的客戶包括許多已建立的全球企業與領先的科技創新者。我們採用「落地並擴展」的商業模式，著重於提供易於採用且具快速價值回報的產品。我們在現有客戶中擴展業務，當客戶增加新渠道、購買額外訂閱產品、實踐新互動策略或納入新業務單位與地理區域時。我們也隨著客戶的成長而成長，因為我們的價格主要根據客戶所能觸及的消費者數量與客戶發送的訊息數量來計算。

Braze 差異化的重要方面在於，我們提供一個平台，而非單一解決方案，讓品牌能透過完整的解決方案達成其客戶互動目標，而不僅僅是發送訊息的工具。我們垂直整合資料活化、洞察與分羣、 orchestrating、個人化與相關性能力，並在堆疊的每一層都運用 AI 投資，因此在這些層面之間協調簡單且快速。同時，我們透過 Braze Data Platform 抽象化不同資料來源的細節，以及我們支援的多種通訊頻道的複雜性，讓行銷人員在 Braze 中實踐其客戶互動策略時，能維持以客戶為中心的思維 – 聚焦於品牌目標與消費者需求的交集，而非資料整合的複雜性或封閉的通訊頻道。這也讓 Braze 的洞察與分羣、 orchestrating 與相關性功能集保持一致性，使客戶更容易跨通訊頻道擴展，並讓我們在 BrazeAI Decisioning Studio 或 BrazeAI Agent Console 或 Braze Canvas 可視化開發環境等領域的研究與開發投資能快速且高效地產生廣泛影響。

此產品架構透過對第一方資料的全面存取，以及直接採取行動引導客戶旅程的能力，支持 AI 與機器學習的差異化運用。當客戶部署我們的平台時，通常會在消費者接觸點與第一方資料來源中進行運用，包括將 Braze 軟體開發套件（SDKs）整合至終端用戶應用程式、ChatGPT 應用程式、基礎 LLM 模型透過 Model Context Protocol（MCP）、網站，以及透過 Braze Data Platform 配置自動連接至客戶資料倉儲或資料平台。這使更先進的實驗與自動決策成為可能，同時也創造了在規模上個人化與優化客戶旅程的機會。透過 BrazeAI，行銷人員可以透過為每位個體量身打造相關內容、旅程與優惠，來改善消費者與品牌的結果。我們的平台也有潛力提高使用 Braze 的團隊的運作效率 – 隨著我們持續擴充產品功能並透過融入 AI 增強其能力，我們可以協助品牌更快地透過 BrazeAI Operator 創造跨通訊頻道的個人化解決方案，並透過自動化實驗與資料分析累積經驗，最終在長遠中提高其投資回報率。

在 orchestrating 層，我們讓行銷人員能輕鬆設計、視覺化並啟動客戶旅程，透過 Canvas，我們專屬的無程式碼旅程 orchestrating 工具。透過 Canvas 的全面旅程測試，行銷人員也能從單一工具中測試、實踐並優化最有效的通訊渠道、頻率、訊息或創意元素。隨著 Canvas 的易用性隨時間改善，越來越多的客戶溝通與互動工作負載已採用此工具，我們相信這鞏固了 Braze 在客戶的科技生態系統中的地位。我們也已開發並持續優化一個 AI 建議引擎，透過自訂訓練的 transformer 模型，將 Braze 目錄中的項目與較可能購買的客戶進行匹配，提供可超越競爭技術的內容個人化功能。

我們支援在產品內與產品外的通訊頻道之間的互動。目前，我們的通訊頻道包括廣泛使用的數位頻道，例如電子郵件；移動通訊，例如 SMS、MMS 和 RCS 訊息、WhatsApp 和 LINE 訊息，以及 webhooks；以及產品內與 web 經驗，例如應用程式內訊息（包括在連接電視與遊戲平台的應用程式內的產品內通訊）、瀏覽器內訊息、問卷、移動與 web 推播通知、Braze Content Cards 和 Banners – 這些是嵌入於移動應用程式或瀏覽器中的靈活且內容豐富的訊息。

Landing Pages – 這些是獨立的網頁，具有單一行動呼籲，通常用於觀眾採集與轉化，以及 Feature Flags – 這些讓我們的客戶能遠端啟用或停用針對不同觀眾的移動或 web 經驗。最後，Braze Audience Sync 也統合了在 Meta、Google、TikTok、Pinterest、Snapchat、LinkedIn、The Trade Desk 和 Criteo 等平台上的自有與付費通訊策略。我們平台的靈活性也讓我們能快速且高效地新增對客戶而言相關的新通訊頻道。

我們讓品牌能輕鬆地將我們的平台與內部技術基礎設施以及我們不斷擴展的頂級技術夥伴生態系統整合。例如，Braze Data Platform 內的機能讓客戶能設置其資料倉儲或平台與 Braze 之間的直接連接，自動同步相關用戶屬性、事件與購買。一旦同步至 Braze，這些資料便可導入我們平台的任何一層，並可用於個人化或分羣等用途。客戶也可透過 Braze Data Platform 將資料即時流式傳輸至這些系統，這會提高客戶在其他科技投資上的回報率。我們支援與多種供應商的直接整合，包括雲端資料服務與倉儲、客戶資料平台、分析與報告解決方案，以及現代行銷科技生態系統的其他元件，例如電商與軟體即服務（SaaS）應用程式。

paragraphs: 以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，應與本年度10-K表報中所包含之合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。除歷史財務資訊外，以下討論包含基於目前計畫、預期與信念之展望性陳述，這些陳述涉及風險與不確定性。我們實際結果可能因多種因素而與這些展望性陳述所預期者有重大差異，包括但不限於本年度10-K表報第一部分第1A項「風險因素」所列述者。請參閱本年度10-K表報中之「關於展望性陳述之特別說明」。
有關我們財務狀況及營運成果於2025年1月31日財務年度與2024年1月31日財務年度之比較討論，請參閱「管理層對財務狀況之討論與分析」
以及營運成果" 係於我們年度報告表 10-K 中所載，該報告係關於我們會計年度終了於 2025 年 1 月 31 日，並於 2025 年 4 月 1 日向美國證券交易委員會 (SEC) 提交。
Braze 為一領導性的客戶互動平台，協助品牌實現絕對的互動效果。我們的平台整合豐富的、來自第一來源的資料，透過可組合的智慧 (模型、代理與運算單元) 將這些資料轉化，並在各通路提供持續且個人化的互動。透過我們的平台，品牌可即時吸收與處理客戶資料，並在多個通路上策劃與優化符合情境的行銷活動。我們的平台設計為使品牌與消費者之間的互動具有與人際互動相同的相關性與跨通路的連續性。
本公司客戶包括許多已建立的全球企業與領導科技創新者，並涵蓋廣泛的規模與產業，包括零售與消費品、媒體與娛樂、遊戲、體育、餐飲與即時服務、醫療與生命科學、科技，以及金融服務。
我們主要透過銷售訂閱服務予客戶以產生營業收入，該訂閱費用主要基於客戶對訊息量、特定每月活躍用戶數、平台存取與/或支援以及某些附加產品的 upfront 承諾。此外，我們提供專業服務，以協助客戶順利上線並使用我們的平台，包括某些高階專業服務，例如電子郵件傳遞支援與專屬技術支援人員。

我們採用 land-and-expand 商業模式，以提供易於採用且具快速價值實現的產品為核心。我們在現有客戶中擴大影響力，當客戶新增通路、購買額外訂閱產品、實踐新互動策略或上線新業務單位與地理區域時。我們也隨著客戶成長而成長，因為我們的價格主要基於客戶所能觸及的消費者數量與客戶所發送的訊息量。因此，當客戶增加使用我們的平台，並增加透過我們平台觸及的終端用戶數量時，我們與這些客戶的契約價值也會增加。

我們在近期期間有顯著成長。我們在財務年度終止於 2026 年 1 月 31 日、2025 年 1 月 31 日及 2024 年 1 月 31 日分別產生 738.2 百萬美元、593.4 百萬美元及 471.8 百萬美元的營業收入，分別代表 2025 年 1 月 31 日至 2026 年 1 月 31 日的年增 24.4%，以及 2024 年 1 月 31 日至 2025 年 1 月 31 日的年增 25.8%。我們在財務年度終止於 2026 年 1 月 31 日、2025 年 1 月 31 日及 2024 年 1 月 31 日分別產生 130.8 百萬美元、104.0 百萬美元及 130.4 百萬美元的淨虧損。我們在財務年度終止於 2026 年 1 月 31 日、2025 年 1 月 31 日及 2024 年 1 月 31 日分別產生 71.4 百萬美元、36.7 百萬美元及 6.9 百萬美元的營運活動產生之淨現金。我們在財務年度終止於 2026 年 1 月 31 日、2025 年 1 月 31 日及 2024 年 1 月 31 日分別產生 58.1 百萬美元、19.6 百萬美元及 (6.5) 百萬美元的非 GAAP 自由現金流。請參閱標題為 "— 非 GAAP 自由現金流" 的部分，以取得更多關於我們如何計算自由現金流（非 GAAP 財務指標）以及與營運活動產生之淨現金（根據美國通用會計準則，或 U.S. GAAP 計算的最直接可比指標）的調整資訊。

我們認為有相當大的機會可以持續擴大客戶羣。我們意圖在已經有強大市場佔有率的垂直領域，例如零售與消費品、媒體與娛樂、電信業者、餐飲與即時服務、醫療與生命科學、科技、製造、教育、政府與公共服務，以及金融服務，繼續擴大客戶羣。同時，我們也計畫透過銷售與行銷努力，抓住正在經歷持續數位轉型的產業，以及直接對消費者關係加速發展的產業，以進一步推動我們技術的採用。截至2026年1月31日，我們在廣泛的規模與產業範圍中擁有2,609位客戶。我們吸引新客戶的能力將取決於多種因素，包括我們產品的品質與價格、競爭對手的產品與我們行銷努力的成效。
我們將客戶定義為與我們有活躍訂閱合約，用以使用我們產品的獨立且區分的最終母公司層級實體。一個組織可能擁有數個獨立的契約部門或子公司，所有這些部門或子公司加起來將被視為單一客戶。
我們認為透過在現有客戶羣中擴大銷售，我們可以實現顯著的成長。我們透過現有客戶擴大使用我們平台的方式，包括增加新通路與提高我們銷售的訊息量
本公司客戶隨著其業務及需求持續成長，並直接與更多消費者連結，這進而導致對更大訊息容量的需求。本公司意圖持續投資於開發與強化我們的產品與功能。本公司能提升對現有客戶的銷售能力，取決於多項因素，包括客戶對我們解決方案的滿意度、客戶吸引新終端用戶的能力、競爭情形、價格以及客戶整體支出水平的變化。

歷史上，我們在平台部署後，曾見證客戶業務有顯著擴張，客戶通常會增加每月活躍用戶數、通路與使用案例，以及購買更多產品。每月活躍用戶是指在過去三十日內曾與客戶應用程式及網站互動的終端用戶。我們在計算每月活躍用戶數時，會將每個可區分的終端用戶納入計算，即使有些用戶可能透過多部裝置存取客戶的應用程式及網站，且多個用戶可能透過同一部裝置存取。截至2026年1月31日，我們擁有約8.0十億每月活躍用戶，較2025年1月31日的約7.2十億每月活躍用戶為高。
Braze 支援跨廣泛的在產品內及產品外訊息頻道的互動。我們平台的靈活性也使我們能迅速且高效地新增新頻道，當這些頻道對客戶變得相關時。我們所提供的頻道廣度，以及我們能高效擴展頻道提供的能力，使我們能在現有客戶購買更多頻道時，擴大我們的影響力。

headings: 與我們成長及資金需求相關的風險
不穩定的市場與經濟環境可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及股價造成嚴重的負面影響。
我們快速的營業收入成長可能無法反映我們未來的營業收入成長。我們快速的營業收入成長也使評估我們未來前景變得困難，並可能增加我們無法成功之風險。
我們可能需要額外資金以支撐業務成長，而此資金可能無法在可接受的條件下取得，甚至可能無法取得。
我們有經營虧損的歷史，未來可能無法達成或維持獲利。
與我們業務及品牌相關的風險
若我們無法吸引新客戶並續約現有客戶，將對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成不利影響。
未能有效發展我們的銷售與行銷能力，可能影響我們擴大客戶羣體及實現平台與產品更廣泛市場採用的能力。
我們依賴單一平台，若未能持續獲得市場接受，可能導致我們的營運結果受損。
我們可能需要降低價格或改變定價模式以維持競爭力。
與大型企業客戶的銷售週期可能長且不可預測，我們的銷售工作需要大量時間與費用。
若客戶對我們或我們合作夥伴所提供的整合、實施或服務不滿意，可能對我們的業務與聲譽產生負面影響。
由於我們通常會根據每份訂閱協議的期限，按比例確認收入，因此我們銷售的上漲或下跌可能不會立即反映在財務狀況與營運結果上。
若我們未能維持並提升品牌，可能影響我們擴大客戶羣體的能力，進而使業務、財務狀況與營運結果受損。
若我們未能有效管理成長，可能無法執行業務計畫、維持高水平的服務與客戶滿意度，或妥善應對競爭挑戰。
paragraphs: 本公司之營運及財務結果受多種風險與不確定性影響，包括下列所列之風險。您應謹慎考量下列所列之風險與不確定性，並配合本年度10-K財務報告中所有其他資訊，包括「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」及我們之合併財務報表與相關附註。下列所列之風險與不確定性並非本公司所面臨之唯一風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前尚未為本公司所知悉，或目前認為較不重要，也可能影響本公司之營運。若下列風險因素中任何事件或情況實現，將可能對本公司之營運、營運結果、財務狀況、現金流與前景造成重大且不利之影響。在此情況下，本公司A類普通股之市場價格可能下跌，您可能損失部分或全部之投資。
本公司之營運受多種風險、因素與不確定性影響，包括那些超出本公司控制範圍之因素，這些因素可能導致本公司實際結果受到損害，包括下列風險：
•不穩定之市場與經濟條件可能對本公司之營運、財務狀況與股價造成嚴重不利影響。
•本公司之營收快速成長可能無法反映未來之營收成長。本公司之營收快速成長也使評估未來前景變得困難，並可能增加本公司無法成功之風險。
•本公司可能需要額外資金以支應營運成長，而此資金可能無法在可接受之條件下取得，甚至無法取得。
•本公司目前營運規模之歷史經驗有限，未來營運結果可能因廣泛之因素而大幅波動，使預測未來營運結果變得困難。
